text:
Another great pass and another pupil Keen On Driving! 

This time it is Albert who passed first time at Nelson Test Centre! 😀

I'm sure he won't mind me saying there were quite a few bad habits to fix after Albert had so much experience driving Land Rovers, quads and tractors around his family farm 🚜

However he was a star pupil who listened to all the advice I gave him and managed to get a well deserved first time pass! 🎉🚗🚦😀

Keep driving safe Albert and take care driving your dad's van! 

Oh and thank you for the bottle of wine. I'm sure I'll enjoy a glass or two on my weekend off 🤣
